statement: let E := fun X : ℕ => (Finset.Icc X (2*X)).filter (fun n => Even n); let P := fun X : ℕ => (Finset.Icc (Nat.sqrt X) (2*Nat.sqrt X)).filter Nat.Prime; let H := fun (X n : ℕ) => ((P X).filter (fun p => p ≤ n ∧ Nat.Prime (n-p))).card; ∀ X : ℕ, 64 ≤ X → (P X).card * ((Finset.Icc X (3*X/2)).filter Nat.Prime).card ≤ ∑ n ∈ E X, H X n

plain_statement.zh: 用一个完整素数矩形给路径总量下界
plain_statement.en: Embed an interior prime rectangle into the path count

brief.zh: 取小素数 p 和区间 [X,3X/2] 中的素数 q。证明 p+q 落在目标偶数区间，并保留第一步以免合并重数。
brief.en: Map the pair to its endpoint and first step. Bound endpoints and check parity before counting.
